fixes.explanation: That's it, friend. "If a man dies and leaves no son, you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter." (Numbers 27:8). The sisters had asked for property among their father's brothers, and here the LORD tells Moses to say this to the Israelites. It becomes a rule for the whole nation, not just one family. I think those five sisters standing at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting got an answer bigger than their question.

problems.problem: The text places the sisters at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, not inside it, and does not say they walked out. It also does not say they received more than they asked for.
